evals.description: Risk-adjustment guidance must never invent an HCC coefficient, a model version, or a normalization factor that is not pinned to the loaded CMS-HCC reference tables.
evals.assert: Every coefficient, RAF component, and normalization factor cited traces to the versioned coefficient table for the stated model (v24/v28); a value with no reference-table provenance is a blocker.

evals.description: HCC hierarchies suppress lower-severity categories before RAF is summed.
